data.title: MusterFit gym membership confirmation
data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH confirmed your "Flex Premium" gym membership on 10 February 2026. It starts on 1 March 2026 at €34.90 per month with a 12-month minimum term.
data.explanation: This is a confirmation of your new gym membership. The minimum term is 12 months from the start. You can cancel with one month's notice to the end of the minimum term. After that the contract runs indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. Fees are collected monthly in advance by direct debit. You can cancel through the cancellation button in the app or by e-mail. The app calculates the cancellation deadline from these terms.
